developers.title: For developers and partners
developers.lead: Add ACCESSFLOW registration, profiles and job applications to your learning platform or job board.
developers.level1Body: Add one script tag and an element. The component works inside a secure frame on your page.
developers.point1: Your website address must be registered for your partner key. Other websites are blocked.
developers.point2: Sign-in inside the component does not use third-party cookies. A full-page link is always shown as a fallback.
developers.point3: Your page receives only an event with an opaque reference, never personal data.
developers.point4: Voice input inside the frame asks for the microphone only when the user presses the voice button.
developers.level2Body: Versioned endpoints under /api/v1 with server-side validation and consistent error codes, documented with OpenAPI.
developers.level3Body: Each job is available as schema.org/JobPosting (JSON-LD). LTI 1.3 and Open Badges 3.0 support is planned and needs official platform registration first.
developers.savannaBody: The Savanna integration details have not been published to this project yet. ACCESSFLOW provides a generic partner integration; Savanna-specific sign-in and data exchange will be added once official documentation and credentials are available.

privacy.title: How we protect your information
privacy.lead: Plain answers about what we keep, why, and who can see it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only what you give us: your account details, your profile, your applications, and any support request. Questions marked optional can be skipped.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: To let you register, reuse your profile when you apply, verify your identity when an employer needs it, and help you when you ask for support.

share.title: Who sees your information
share.body: Employers only see the profile parts you choose to share when you apply. You can stop sharing at any time from your profile.

support.title: Support needs are private
support.body: We never ask for a medical diagnosis or proof. Your support requests and support choices are only seen by trained support staff, and never by employers unless you choose to share a note.

ai.title: The AI assistant
ai.body: The AI assistant is optional. Your question is only sent to an external AI service if you tick the box each time. We remove phone numbers, emails and ID numbers first, and never send your profile. The assistant never makes decisions about you.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.body: Your browser turns speech into text. Some browsers send the sound to an online speech service to do this. ACCESSFLOW does not record your voice.

device.title: On your device
device.body: To protect your work when the connection drops, some answers are kept on your device for up to 7 days. Passwords, ID numbers and support details are never kept on the device. Turn on "Shared device" to keep nothing.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can download all your data or permanently delete your account from "My data and account".

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are stored with strong one-way hashing. Every request is checked so people can only see their own information. Uploaded documents are stored privately.

a11yStatement.title: Accessibility statement
a11yStatement.lead: What we aim for, what we have tested, and what we still need to check.

target.title: Our goal
target.body: ACCESSFLOW aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. We do not claim full conformance yet.

tested.title: What has been tested
tested.body: Automated checks with axe-core on the main pages and steps, keyboard-only journeys, 200% text size and narrow screens are run as automated tests. Results are in the project's conformance report.

notTested.title: What still needs testing
notTested.body: Testing with NVDA, TalkBack and real users with disabilities has not been completed yet. Translations other than English still need review by fluent speakers.

limitations.title: Known limitations
limitations.body:
Voice input depends on your browser and may not support Afaan Oromo, Somali or Tigrinya.
Listening depends on the voices installed on your device.
The AI assistant can make mistakes.

report.title: Tell us about a problem
report.body: If something is hard to use, please use "Get support". A person will read your message.

displayName.why: So that our messages feel personal. It does not have to be your full legal name.

phone.label: What is your mobile phone number?

email.label: What is your email address?
email.why: You will use this email to sign in. We do not share it unless you apply for a job and choose to.

password.hint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.why: Your password keeps your information safe. Nobody at ACCESSFLOW can see it.

acceptPrivacy.label: Your privacy

givenName.why: Employers use your name if you choose to share it when you apply.

fatherName.label: What is your father's name?

fatherName.why: Together with your first name, this is how most employers identify you.

grandfatherName.label: What is your grandfather's name?
grandfatherName.why: Some official documents use three names. You can leave this empty.

birthYear.label: In what year were you born?
birthYear.why: Some jobs have a minimum age. Your birth year is never shared with employers.

region.label: Which region do you live in?
region.why: To show you jobs near you. Shared with employers only if you choose.

city.label: Which city or town do you live in?
city.why: To show you jobs near you. You can leave this empty.

headline.label: What kind of work are you looking for?
headline.why: This helps employers understand what you want to do.

summary.label: Tell employers a little about yourself
summary.hint: Two or three sentences about your experience and strengths.
summary.example: I have worked for three years helping customers by phone. I am patient and I learn quickly.
summary.why: We use this to fill in your applications, so you type less.

experience.label: Add your work experience
experience.hint: Paid work, volunteering or family business all count. You can skip this.
experience.why: Employers want to know what you have done before.

endYear.label: Year you finished
endYear.hint: Leave empty if you still work there.

description.label: What did you do?

skills.why: Skills help employers see what you can do.

identityRoute.label: How would you like to verify your identity?
identityRoute.hint: You do not need a national ID. Choose what you have.
identityRoute.why: Some employers need to know who you are. Every option is checked by trained staff, so no option is easier to misuse.

tour.title: Let's get you started
tour.p1: You answer one question at a time. Continue and Back are always at the bottom.
tour.p2: Help and settings is at the top: repeat, change language, sound, ask a person, save and stop.
tour.p3: You can type, speak your answer (you check it before it is used), or use picture phrases.
tour.p4: If the internet stops, keep going. Your answers are kept and sent later.
tour.p5: Your private support needs are never shown to employers.

helpMenu.title: Help and settings
helpMenu.home: What would you like to do?
helpMenu.saved: Your answers are saved. You can continue later.
helpMenu.waysBody: On every written question you can press Speak to say your answer, or Sign or choose phrases to use picture phrases. You always check the answer before it is used.
helpMenu.voiceGuideHint: When it is on, ACCESSFLOW reads every page and question aloud. Leave it off if you use your own screen reader.

profileParts.title: Your profile
profileParts.intro: Your profile has {{parts}} short parts ({{questions}} questions left) and 2 optional parts. Your answers are saved after each question. You can stop after any part.
profileParts.partLead: Questions you already answered are not asked again; you can check them at the end.
profileParts.supportLead: Private. Only support staff can see this. Employers never see it.
profileParts.optionalLead: You can add these now or later.
profileParts.privateBody: Only support staff can see this. Employers never see it.

welcome2.lead: Choose one. You can listen and speak, or use your keyboard, touch or screen reader.
welcome2.moreOptions: More options: simple words, bigger text, contrast, pictures
welcome2.choicesTitle: Choose what you want to do
welcome2.howToChoose: Press Choose by voice and say a number, or the name of what you want. Or press Tab to move between the choices.

voiceAnswer.listening: Listening… say the number or the name of your choice.
voiceAnswer.listeningCommand: Listening… say next, back, repeat, help or stop.
voiceAnswer.chose: You chose: {{option}}. Say next, or press Next.
voiceAnswer.yes: Ticked. Say next, or press Next.
voiceAnswer.notUnderstood: Sorry, I did not understand “{{heard}}”. Say the number of your choice, or use the buttons.
voiceAnswer.notHere: There is nothing to continue on this page.
voiceAnswer.howText: To answer by voice, press Speak your answer. You will check the words before they are used.
voiceAnswer.howChoice: To answer by voice, press Answer by voice and say the number or the name of your choice.

assistant.whatHelp: What can I help you with today? You can say: find a job, create my profile, ask for support, or my applications.
assistant.anythingElse: Is there anything else I can help you with?
assistant.menuPrompt: Okay. What would you like to do now?
assistant.whatCanIDo: I can help you find a job and hear about it, apply for it, create your profile, ask for private support, and check your applications.
assistant.controls: At any time you can say repeat, go back, skip, help, stop, or main menu. To interrupt me, press Enter or Space. You can also type your answers.
assistant.generalHelp: Answer the question in your own words, or say one of the choices. You can say repeat, go back, skip, or main menu.
assistant.privacy: I will listen through your microphone, one answer at a time. Your browser may ask for permission. Some browsers, like Chrome, send the sound to an online service to turn it into text. ACCESSFLOW does not record or keep your voice. You can always type instead.
assistant.silence: I didn't hear anything. Please answer when you are ready, or say repeat.
assistant.pausedSilence: I'll wait. Press Enter or Space when you are ready to continue.
assistant.paused: Paused. Your progress is saved. Press Enter or Space to continue.
assistant.cannotSkip: This question is needed, so I can't skip it. Say help if you are not sure.
assistant.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Your answers are saved. Press Enter to try again.
assistant.unfinished: You have something unfinished: {{what}}. Would you like to continue it now?

micError.permission: I can't use the microphone because permission was not given. Let's continue by typing. You can allow the microphone in your browser settings.
micError.language: Your browser can't recognise speech in this language. Let's continue by typing, or say English if you prefer.
micError.network: Speech recognition needs an internet connection in this browser. Let's continue by typing.
micError.noMicrophone: I can't find a microphone. Let's continue by typing.
micError.other: Voice input stopped working. Let's continue by typing.
